```{r}
#| label: setup
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))

if (!exists("SRS_UNITS", inherits = FALSE)) SRS_UNITS <- "mm"
SelectionTable <- .srsDeckSelections(
  params, root,
  path = if (exists("PathSRS", inherits = FALSE)) PathSRS else NULL
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
  PathSRS <- SelectionTable$PathSRS[[i]]
  PSWTable <- data.table::fread(file.path(PathSRS, "data", "PSW.csv"))
  TARGET_FILE <- file.path(PathSRS, "match", "target.csv")
  if (exists("TargetTable", inherits = FALSE)) rm(TargetTable)
  if (file.exists(TARGET_FILE)) TargetTable <- data.table::fread(TARGET_FILE)
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/srs.psa.qmd",
    stem = if (nrow(SelectionTable) > 1L) {
      paste(SelectionTable$key[[i]], "srs-psa", sep = "-")
    } else {
      "srs-psa"
    },
    labels = if (nrow(SelectionTable) > 1L) "rewrite" else "keep",
    vars = list(TITLE = sprintf(
        "Selected Ground-Motion Suite%s<br>Pseudo-Spectral Acceleration",
        if (nrow(SelectionTable) > 1L) {
          sprintf(" — %s", SelectionTable$label[[i]])
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )),
    root = root
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "i", "ID", "DIR", "PathSRS", "SRS_UNITS", "PSWTable", "TARGET_FILE",
  "TargetTable", "SelectionTable"
), ls()))
```
